title: 0–3s: Wide shot of a busy city park in daylight. A playful dog grabs a police…
content:
0–3s: Wide shot of a busy city park in daylight. A playful dog grabs a police officer’s cap from a bench and suddenly runs away. Nearby people turn and laugh in surprise.
3–6s: The police officer notices and starts chasing the dog with a completely serious expression, running like it is an important emergency.
6–9s: Handheld chase shot following the dog as it races across the park, dodging benches, bicycles, pedestrians, and picnic tables while carrying the cap.
9–12s: The officer tries to cut across the path, trips slightly over a low curb, regains balance, and continues chasing with dramatic action-movie energy.
12–15s: The dog jumps onto a bench, drops the cap, sits beside it, and looks proudly at the exhausted officer.
Style: ultra-realistic, cinematic action-comedy, handheld chase camera, natural daylight, lifelike dog motion, realistic people, subtle camera shake, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens look, natural colors, documentary realism.

es.content:
0–3s: Plano general de un concurrido parque urbano a plena luz del día. Un perro juguetón le arrebata la gorra a un policía de un banco y de repente sale corriendo. Las personas cercanas se giran y se ríen, sorprendidas.  
3–6s: El policía se da cuenta y empieza a perseguir al perro con una expresión completamente seria, corriendo como si se tratara de una emergencia importante.  
6–9s: Toma en mano siguiendo al perro mientras atraviesa el parque a toda velocidad, esquivando bancos, bicicletas, peatones y mesas de picnic mientras lleva la gorra.  
9–12s: El policía intenta cortar por el camino, tropieza ligeramente con un bordillo bajo, recupera el equilibrio y sigue persiguiéndolo con una energía dramática de película de acción.  
12–15s: El perro salta a un banco, deja caer la gorra, se sienta a su lado y mira con orgullo al policía, ya exhausto.  
Style: ultra-realistic, cinematic action-comedy, handheld chase camera, natural daylight, lifelike dog motion, realistic people, subtle camera shake, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens look, natural colors, documentary realism.

fr.content:
0–3 s : Plan large d’un parc urbain très fréquenté en plein jour. Un chien joueur attrape la casquette d’un policier sur un banc et s’enfuit soudainement. Les personnes à proximité se retournent et rient, surprises.  
3–6 s : Le policier s’en aperçoit et se lance à la poursuite du chien avec une expression totalement sérieuse, courant comme s’il s’agissait d’une urgence importante.  
6–9 s : Plan de poursuite à la caméra portée suivant le chien tandis qu’il traverse le parc à toute vitesse, esquivant bancs, vélos, passants et tables de pique-nique tout en transportant la casquette.  
9–12 s : Le policier tente de couper à travers le chemin, trébuche légèrement sur un petit trottoir, retrouve son équilibre et continue la poursuite avec une énergie de film d’action spectaculaire.  
12–15 s : Le chien saute sur un banc, laisse tomber la casquette, s’assoit à côté et regarde fièrement le policier épuisé.  
Style : ultra-réaliste, action-comedy cinématographique, caméra de poursuite à l’épaule, lumière naturelle du jour, mouvements du chien réalistes, personnes réalistes, léger tremblement de caméra, faible profondeur de champ, rendu d’objectif 35 mm, couleurs naturelles, réalisme documentaire.

ja.content:
0～3秒: 昼間の賑やかな都市公園のワイドショット。いたずら好きな犬がベンチから警察官の帽子をくわえて、突然走り去る。近くにいた人々は振り向き、驚いて笑う。  
3～6秒: 警察官がそれに気づき、完全に真剣な表情で犬を追いかけ始める。まるで重大な緊急事態のように走る。  
6～9秒: 犬を追う handheld の chase shot。帽子をくわえたまま、公園内を駆け抜け、ベンチ、自転車、歩行者、ピクニックテーブルを器用に避けていく。  
9～12秒: 警察官が近道をしようとして低い縁石につまずきかけるが、バランスを取り戻し、ドラマチックなアクション映画のような勢いで追跡を続ける。  
12～15秒: 犬がベンチに飛び乗り、帽子を落としてその横に座り、疲れ切った警察官を誇らしげに見つめる。  
Style: ultra-realistic, cinematic action-comedy, handheld chase camera, natural daylight, lifelike dog motion, realistic people, subtle camera shake, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens look, natural colors, documentary realism.

ko.content:
0–3초: 낮 시간의 번화한 도시 공원 와이드 샷. 장난기 많은 개가 벤치 위에 있던 경찰관의 모자를 낚아채더니 갑자기 달아난다. 주변 사람들은 돌아보며 놀라 웃는다.  
3–6초: 경찰관이 이를 알아차리고, 마치 중대한 긴급 상황인 것처럼 매우 진지한 표정으로 개를 쫓기 시작한다.  
6–9초: 개를 따라가는 핸드헬드 추격 샷. 개는 모자를 물고 공원 곳곳을 가로지르며 벤치, 자전거, 보행자, 피크닉 테이블을 피해 질주한다.  
9–12초: 경찰관이 지름길로 가려다 낮은 연석에 살짝 걸려 비틀거리지만, 균형을 되찾고 드라마틱한 액션 영화 같은 에너지로 추격을 계속한다.  
12–15초: 개가 벤치 위로 뛰어올라 모자를 떨어뜨리고, 그 옆에 앉아 지친 경찰관을 자랑스럽게 바라본다.  
Style: ultra-realistic, cinematic action-comedy, handheld chase camera, natural daylight, lifelike dog motion, realistic people, subtle camera shake, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens look, natural colors, documentary realism.

pt.content:
0–3s: Plano geral de um parque urbano movimentado durante o dia. Um cachorro brincalhão pega o boné de um policial de um banco e, de repente, sai correndo. Pessoas próximas se viram e riem, surpresas.  
3–6s: O policial percebe e começa a perseguir o cachorro com uma expressão completamente séria, correndo como se fosse uma emergência importante.  
6–9s: Plano de perseguição em handheld acompanhando o cachorro enquanto ele atravessa o parque em disparada, desviando de bancos, bicicletas, pedestres e mesas de piquenique enquanto carrega o boné.  
9–12s: O policial tenta cortar caminho pela trilha, tropeça levemente em um meio-fio baixo, recupera o equilíbrio e continua a perseguição com energia dramática de filme de ação.  
12–15s: O cachorro pula em um banco, deixa o boné cair, senta ao lado dele e olha orgulhosamente para o policial exausto.  
Style: ultra-realistic, cinematic action-comedy, handheld chase camera, natural daylight, lifelike dog motion, realistic people, subtle camera shake, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens look, natural colors, documentary realism.

zh.content:
0–3秒：白天繁忙城市公园的广角镜头。一只顽皮的狗从长椅上叼走一名警察的帽子，突然跑开。附近的人们转过头来，惊讶又好笑地看着这一幕。  
3–6秒：警察发现后，表情严肃到近乎一本正经，开始追赶那只狗，跑得像是在处理一场重要的紧急事件。  
6–9秒：手持追逐镜头跟拍那只狗，它叼着帽子在公园里飞奔，灵巧地躲开长椅、自行车、行人和野餐桌。  
9–12秒：警察试图抄近路，轻微绊到一处低矮路缘，随即稳住身体，带着夸张的动作片气势继续追赶。  
12–15秒：狗跳上一张长椅，把帽子放下，坐在旁边，得意地看着已经筋疲力尽的警察。  
风格：超写实、cinematic 动作喜剧、手持追逐镜头、自然日光、逼真的狗的动作、真实的人物、轻微镜头抖动、浅景深、35mm 镜头质感、自然色彩、纪录片式真实感。
